svg.title: Dependency stages for twelve data analysis skills
svg.desc: Eight left-to-right stages connect twelve fictional skills. Values and types starts the graph. Functions waits for both collections and control flow. The reproducible mini-project is last because it depends on analysis validation and chart explanation.
